sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report relates to customer C10434 and card account C10434-K1. On 2016-12-02 at 15:18:27, an online transaction (ID 3506725) was conducted for product R in region 469 totaling $1,000.03. The transaction was flagged by real-time monitoring with a risk score of 0.90. The transaction was processed via device profile D000253 running Windows 10 and Edge 16.0. Identity records confirm that device D000253 was newly observed on this customer account. The transaction amount of $1,000.03 represents a significant deviation from the account baseline of 33 transactions averaging $131.25, yielding a z-score of 4.9. Furthermore, case memory shows 4 of the 5 most similar prior cases were confirmed fraud under card-not-present typologies. Supervised machine learning models calibrated the fraud probability for this incident at 0.94 under the card_not_present_new_device pattern. Due to confirmed fraudulent indicators and an exposure amount of $1,000.03 exceeding the $1,000 threshold, the card was blocked and this report is submitted.
